title: IndoCulture: Exploring Geographically-Influenced Cultural Commonsense Reasoning Across Eleven Indonesian Provinces

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on the IndoCulture dataset using zero-shot multiple-choice and sentence completion tasks to test their understanding of geographically-influenced cultural commonsense, norms, and artifacts across eleven Indonesian provinces.

Comparing model performance on original Indonesian prompts versus English-translated prompts to investigate Anglocentric biases and the effect of the prompt language on cultural reasoning capabilities.
